name: Podcast audiogram
description: Full-frame podcast audiogram: cover art with a slow Ken Burns over its own blurred backdrop, show and episode titles, a mirrored waveform driven by the project audio (studio.level, beat-pulse fallback), word-highlighted captions (transcript words or your text) and a progress bar with elapsed time; use to promote podcast or interview clips (16:9 and 9:16 layouts).
